popCulture.title: Iphis
popCulture.description: Ovid's Cretan wedding tale — a girl raised as a boy, love for Ianthe, and Isis' gift of a male body on the eve of the rites.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book IX holds Ligdus' vow, Telethusa's deception, and the goddess who answers a mother's prayer — still the West's classic sex-change myth.

popCulture.title: Isis
popCulture.description: The Egyptian goddess who walks Ovid's Crete — the deity Telethusa trusts when no Greek god will remake her child.
